alt: Eight posts in a Discord support forum for a self-hosted photo library go through an LLM that extracts each thread's question and answer; the three posts about long video uploads that never finish behind a proxy are merged by entity resolution into one FAQ.md entry asked 3 times, the library-move entry gives the maintainer's corrected answer, the unanswered question about original file names is listed under Open questions, and "Show us your setup", which asks nothing, gets no entry; answering the file-names post sends only that thread back to the LLM.
needs: Discord bot in your server (Message Content intent on)
OPENAI_API_KEY (or LLM_MODEL and RESOLUTION_LLM_MODEL with their provider's key)

run.note: Configure (set the API key, DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and DISCORD_CHANNEL_IDS in .env) and install
Optional: fill a forum with made-up support posts through its webhook
Build FAQ.md (re-run after the threads change)
